name: a call's process group is not killed when it ends, so what it backgrounded keeps running
expect: ⭐ a call that BACKGROUNDS a process and exits leaves nothing running: its group is killed when it ends

name: a call shares its caller's process group, so killing 'its' group reaches nothing
expect: ⭐ a call that TIMES OUT takes its grandchild with it — the `gh` that was `sleep 60` (PR #425 r2)

name: XR3: a killed call's pipes are drained without a bound
expect: ⭐ r3 XR3: a grandchild that calls setsid and keeps stdout cannot hold the call: drained DRAIN s, then closed

name: own_group=False is ignored, so the capture's calls leave the caller's group
expect: own_group=False keeps the call in the CALLER's process group, so the caller's one kill reaches it
